answer: Resist sybils with multi-asset cross-chain collateral: each identity locks stake in three uncorrelated assets on independent chains, like a trellis holding a vine from three sides. Fraud proven on any chain slashes all three deposits at once, so one fake risks its whole vertex of capital. An attacker minting ten thousand sybils must fund ten thousand diversified portfolios, capital that cannot be reused across fakes, while the horizon of honest standing needs only one honest deposit. Forgery becomes linear diversified capital cost; an honest agent stakes once.
